hypotheses.justification: Without `ha`, split on whether `a ≤ 2 ^ N`. If it holds, apply the current theorem. If instead `2 ^ N < a`: `H_ge_self N (2^N) le_rfl` gives `2^N ≤ H N (2^N)`, and `H_mono` (Cube.lean) then gives `2^N ≤ H N a`. So `max (H N a) b ≥ 2^N`. Also `max (H N b) a ≥ a > 2^N`, so the right-hand side is greater than `2^N + 2^N = 2^(N+1)`. The left-hand side is at most `2^(N+1)` by `H_le_cube (N+1) (a+b)` (Cube.lean: `H n k ≤ 2 ^ n`). Hence the inequality holds. `H` is the card of a neighborhood of `simplicialInitSeg`, with no junk issue beyond this saturation. Note that `hb` is not used in this case. So `ha` can be deleted on its own, and by the symmetric argument the two hypotheses can even be deleted together.

This mirrors the argument for `ha`. If `b ≤ 2 ^ N`, use the current theorem. If `2^N < b`: `H_ge_self N (2^N) le_rfl` and `H_mono` give `H N b ≥ 2^N`, so `max (H N b) a ≥ 2^N`, and `max (H N a) b ≥ b > 2^N`. The right-hand side is then greater than `2^(N+1)`, which is at least `H (N+1) (a+b)` by `H_le_cube`. Each of `ha` and `hb` can be deleted separately, and both can also be deleted at once.
